dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Ah, I... I'm fine, don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I just get sentimental sometimes on nights like this, as I listen to the din in the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: It brings me back to the days when I and Stanley had just started adventuring together. We'd always drink ourselves under the table the night before setting out.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's alright. I'll get up. For his sake, I definitely will.
